title: Shift to Quiet Before Bed | Parenting Rewind
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: A fast game right before lights out can leave a child's body excited while the clock says it is time to sleep. Demanding instant calm after active play asks the transition to do too much work at once. Pause and move the energetic activity earlier in the evening. Build a quiet final sequence such as washing, pajamas, one book, and a brief cuddle in the same order. A calm predictable routine gives the child repeated cues that the day is slowing down and sleep comes next.

source.title: Toddler Bedtime Trouble: 7 Tips for Parents
